fit_eval_rule: Exact usable development membership remains PRE-only gated by immutable race membership, competition_score validity, official registration identity, source timing and missingness. Any block used to estimate rider affinity or a global parameter is development and cannot be called independent evaluation. Final advancement requires the v2 玉野/防府 pair unless a new pre-outcome superseding lock is created before any development target is viewed.
support_gate: Do not fit a rider-specific affinity term merely from venue contrasts. A separate PRE-only repeated-rider support gate must pass before formula lock; sparse riders remain explicit unsupported, never silently zero-imputed.
formula_gate: Exact low-DOF predictive formula, rider-support threshold, parameter estimation/shrinkage rule, primary metric, race-level cluster bootstrap and advancement criterion must be frozen before any development RESULT join.
